entries.summary: Expanded baseline catalog with 3 new high-value agents (Security Auditor, Performance Engineer, Data Engineer) and supporting skills as part of #264 ACs for catalog expansion. Updated unit test expectations and assertions. Agents are surfaced via existing plate_agents / delegation. Fragment for agent surface change.

entries.agent_notes: Use plate_delegate_to_agent with 'security-auditor', 'performance-engineer', or 'data-engineer' for specialized tasks. Update plate.agent.md or guidance in follow-ups if needed. Supports extension contrib per AC (via provided_by in future).
